settings.heading: View the 2017 study
settings.content:
Scientists study spermidine for cell health. A 2017 trial tested a daily spermidine complex in 100 healthy adults for 90 days. The people taking the complex had more follicles in mature growth phases than the placebo group. This early study did not test the Goodwell formula. It did not measure hair growth in people on weight loss drugs.

A spermidine-based nutritional supplement prolongs the anagen phase of hair follicles in humans

settings.heading: Will this stop my drug-linked hair loss?
settings.row_content: Hair loss during fast weight loss has many causes. Scientists study spermidine for the hair growth phase. But this formula is not proven to stop GLP-1 hair loss. Talk to a doctor if you worry about sudden shedding.

settings.heading: Why spermidine instead of biotin or collagen?
settings.row_content: You may already take basic vitamins and eat enough protein. Spermidine offers a different path. Science links it directly to the active growth phase of the hair follicle.

settings.heading: Is this the exact formula used in the clinical study?
settings.row_content: No. The 2017 study used an undisclosed spermidine complex. Goodwell gives you a clear dose. You get 10mg of Spermidine 3HCL with rice flour in two simple capsules.

settings.question: Will this stop hair shedding from my GLP-1 medication?
settings.answer: No supplement can guarantee an end to medication-related shedding. Goodwell Spermidine provides an ingredient studied for supporting the natural growing phase of the hair cycle. It offers proactive biological support, not a proven cure for GLP-1 side effects.

settings.question: How long does hair biology take to shift?
settings.answer: Hair cycles change slowly. The preliminary human study on oral spermidine measured markers of the growing phase after 90 days of consistent use. Supporting your follicles is a steady habit, not an overnight cosmetic fix.

settings.question: Can I take this with my weight-loss prescription?
settings.answer: Always consult your prescribing doctor before adding any supplement to your routine, especially when taking medications that alter your metabolism or weight. We do not promise compatibility with specific prescription drugs.
